**SayGM Profile:**

**Primary Purpose:** OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway with hardware-verified privacy, running on Bittensor's decentralized network.

**Core Features:** Access to frontier models (GPT, Claude, Gemini); Intel TDX enclave processing; prompts decrypted only within enclave; live model pricing; pay-per-use (no subscription); open-source attestation verification.

**Pricing Model:** Pay-per-token at best-available rates per provider (~31% off OpenAI's GPT-5 listed example). No subscriptions or credit fees.

**Target Users:** AI builders, agents, enterprises requiring privacy compliance; cost-conscious API consumers.

**Key Differentiators:** Hardware-verified privacy (Intel-signed attestation visible on-site); decentralized routing via Bittensor (SN28); claimed 45% cheaper than OpenRouter; open models run fully inside TEE.

**Value Proposition:** Private, verifiable access to every frontier model at optimal pricing—privacy not policy-promised but cryptographically guaranteed.

runs.task: Research openrouter.ai in detail. Identify: primary purpose, core features, pricing model, target users, key differentiators, and main value proposition. Provide a concise profile.
runs.reply_preview:
**OPENROUTER.AI PROFILE**

**Primary Purpose:** Unified API gateway for accessing 400+ LLMs across multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, etc.) via a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

**Core Features:** Multi-model routing; aggregated billing; provider uptime pooling; free model router; analytics dashboard; 61M-1.05M token context windows supported.

**Pricing:** Pass-through provider rates ($0.0000025–$4.40/M tokens range observed); no markup; single credit pool consolidates spending across all models.

**Target Users:** Individual engineers, AI hobbyists, startups exploring LLM cost optimization and performance improvements; secondary: enterprises seeking gateway control.

**Key Differentiators:** Eliminates multi-account management; OpenAI API compatibility enables zero-code switching; structural market plurality philosophy; free tier available.

**Value Proposition:** One API key, one dashboard, one billing statement for seamless experimentation across hundreds of models without provider lock-in.
